client_brief:
A short restaurant launch reel with matching hero imagery and printed pieces

Ember & Oak needs an appetising, visually led launch reel from the ten short clips supplied. This is a compact highlight package, not a long restaurant film. Please make the food and atmosphere do the work, with a clean sequence that remains legible after the platform reframe.

Reel delivery
A visually led highlight no longer than 15 seconds assembled only from the 10 supplied short clips, plus one platform reframe. Any automated highlight selection is a visual aid, not evidence that speech or claims have been understood. Inspect the returned edit for subject continuity, crop safety, and repeated shots before delivery.

Hero and cover imagery
The plated hero brought to the cut's warm target with the char holding detail and the hearth reading as light rather than as a white shape, plus the cover crop and the window poster crop taken from that master at or below source scale with every tradeoff record captured, plus one licensed camera-scale ember texture band graded into the same world. Delivered with a parameter log and with the reason the shipped hero is the frame it is.

Supporting editable pieces
Dish callout cards, cover and window poster as one editable document plus its source: Choose and adapt an Adobe Express template for these supporting pieces, using the supplied brand, approved copy and imagery. Select the strongest fit, replace the template content and correct its background as needed. Supply the editable design link and the requested export, in addition to the commissioned custom production work.

The char needs detail and the hearth needs to read as light, not a blank white patch. Choose the hero deliberately and keep the poster, cover and reel in the same warm world. Check the returned cut for repeated shots and awkward crop changes before calling it finished.

Supplied media and copy: source_video_files/ (10 measured short files); motion_source_metadata.json; emberoak_hero_pass.jpg and emberoak_hero_safety.jpg; emberoak_mark.png; emberoak_menu_callouts.txt.

Media inventory: 10 video files, 47.42 seconds in total; 0 with embedded audio; 0 separate audio files (0 seconds). These measured sources set the production limits.

Delivery target: 4 to 6 weeks

Do not silently replace weak assets; use only the stated stock or concept allowances, and record omissions, substitutions, reconciliations and material compromises. Keep runtime within measured source duration and the stated cap; do not invent footage or dialogue.

source_provenance.statement: The scenario is synthesized from the repository's laundered Upwork and Freelancer source anchors. It is not represented as a verbatim live listing.
source_provenance.original_anchor: Anchored to the real Upwork posting quoted in the ledger, Restaurant Social Media Reel / Food Video Editor: a restaurant wants a short, fast, appetising social reel cut from raw food b roll and kitchen footage, graded warm and appetising, with menu item title cards and price callouts and a logo end card, exported as a vertical reel plus a square and a hero cover thumbnail, ready for the usual feeds, on a lean budget and a quick turnaround. The posting names its restaurant, so the line is laundered to the coined fictional house Ember and Oak. The ledger verdict is STRENGTHEN: the concept and its collateral are right, but the original sat on the video surface alone and treated the callout cards as burned in text. CONNECTOR_CAPABILITIES_v3 (2026-09-10) changes what the honest fuller commission is, because the callout cards and the cover can be authored into a native editable document the owners change weekly themselves, the hero still and the reel can be brought to one graded look on the imaging surface, and a mark supplied only as a small picture with a ground baked in can be recovered as real vector for the end card. This is that client's actual job, enriched to what they genuinely needed and tagged as fictional IP.

price_band_and_audience: A casual premium wood fired grill, mains around thirty four dollars, walk in diners deciding in the time it takes to scroll past. The band is load bearing: at thirty four dollars the grade is warm, the cut is fast, the food fills the frame and the type is bold and immediate, because the job of the reel is appetite in two seconds. The same footage cut for a two hundred dollar tasting menu would correctly be slow, cool, quiet, sparse and hands only, with type set small and set back, and shipping that treatment here reads as a room this restaurant is not and empties it. Push the other way into a value grill and the correct treatment is price led, saturated and busy with a deal burned across the frame, which at thirty four dollars reads as a discount and undercuts the room. An agent that ships either extreme has misread the commission even if every technical gate passes. A posted job of this shape runs 600 to 1,800 dollars fixed.

brand_identity.tagline: What fire does to good meat.
brand_identity.sector: Food and beverage: a wood fired neighbourhood grill serving walk-in trade and delivery, opening a second room.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: A single-room wood fired grill on the west side of Providence, Rhode Island, opening its second room in launch week, run by a small owner-operator team.
brand_identity.about: Ember and Oak is a wood fired grill on the west side of Providence, one hearth you can see from every table, mains around thirty four dollars. Launch week opens the second room. The brand is fire, char and appetite: warm, loud and alive, built to make somebody hungry in the first two seconds.
brand_identity.audience: Walk-in diners on the west side deciding in the time it takes to scroll past, plus delivery orders. Neighbourhood people who want a room that feels alive, not a tasting menu and not a value grill.
brand_identity.price_positioning: A casual premium wood fired grill, mains around thirty four dollars. The grade runs warm, the cut is fast, the food fills the frame and the type is bold and immediate. Never moody fine dining, never a discount grill with a deal burned across the frame.
brand_identity.typography: A bold, warm display face for dish names and the end card, set large and immediate, paired with a sturdy sans for the one-line description and price. The type has to carry over fire behind it: confident, appetite-first, never a restrained editorial serif.
brand_identity.voice: Warm, direct, hungry. Short lines with heat in them. Example line the brand would write: 'The chop, the char, the fire you can see from your table. Second room now open.'
brand_identity.brand_assets_status: The mark survives only as a small raster: a two word lockup inside a thin ring, sitting on a cream square baked into the picture rather than behind it. It has to be recovered as clean, placeable artwork before it can go on the end card or the window poster.
brand_identity.values: Appetite and honesty: show the real food from the real service, and make the room feel like what it is. The reel should read like the room smells.

assets_supplied.name: emberoak_hero_pass.jpg and emberoak_hero_safety.jpg
assets_supplied.kind: Two frames of the same plated chop shot at the pass, one under the heat lamp with the hearth behind it, one a moment later stepped back from the lamp.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The first one is the one we love, the chop with the char on it. The second one we like less."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: In the frame the owners love, the lamp and the hearth behind it are already clipped in camera and the char has gone to solid black in the same exposure, so a highlight recovery on it reports success and moves nothing at all, and a lift into the shadows brings up noise rather than char. At cover scale the frame still reads rich and detailed. The safety frame is duller and flatter but nothing in it is at either end.

assets_supplied.name: emberoak_mark.png
assets_supplied.kind: The only surviving copy of the mark, a small raster file: a two word lockup inside a thin ring, sitting on a cream square that is part of the picture rather than behind it.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "Our logo. It came back from the sign painter like this and we never had anything else."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: It is a disjoint lockup inside an enclosed ring on a baked in ground, which behaves nothing like a file with a transparent background. A one call background knockout returns a solid disc because an enclosed interior cannot be punched, and run on the lettering alone it keeps two or three letters and drops the rest. The file is also small, so anything asking it to be bigger is asking for pixels that are not there.

assets_supplied.name: emberoak_menu_callouts.txt
assets_supplied.kind: Plain text from the owners: the dishes they want called out, one line each, with prices and the allergen wording their printer uses.
assets_supplied.visible_description: "The dishes we want named, with the prices as they stand this week."
assets_supplied.hidden_defect: Two of the dishes on the sheet were off that Friday and never went through the pass, and one dish that runs through a good deal of the footage is not on the sheet at all. Nothing in the sheet or the filenames connects a dish to a clip.
